name: World Monitor
description: Real-time global intelligence on conflict, markets, energy, trade, shipping and cyber through World Monitor's hosted MCP server. About 100 read-only tools: world news briefs with sources, country risk briefs, armed conflict events, maritime chokepoints and energy exposure, natural hazards, markets and macro, trade, and cyber. Requires a free World Monitor account via OAuth; some advanced tools need a paid plan.
